entries.152c92c61157cbd4: As its management policy, it states that it will thoroughly provide products and services that suit customer needs and adapt to the industry environment of each business, and will promote the creation of revenue through high value added products and services and further enhancement of corporate value. By business, it cites the following: in the Mobile Telecommunications Business, creating a new form of sales outlet by leveraging the strength of its face-to-face customer touchpoints at mobile phone stores; in the Staffing Business, strengthening expansion into high value added fields by repurposing and sharing the training system for engineering dispatch; in the Store Sublease Business, procuring highly marketable store properties and accelerating the growth of the store rent guarantee business; and in the Wholesale Business, shifting to high value added products and strengthening e-commerce sales, among others. It also aims to improve the performance of group companies through structural reforms of existing businesses, and to expand the group’s scale of operations through acquiring new businesses via M&A and alliances.

entries.f120b097e7d627c4: Its core strength lies in its status as a primary agent of KDDI, with a business relationship dating back to 1989, and a sales network of 77 au shops and 9 UQ Spot stores spanning mainly Aichi Prefecture and extending into the Tokyo metropolitan area. In December 2022, it concluded a capital and business alliance agreement with KDDI, further strengthening the relationship in terms of capital. In the Store Sublease Business, the number of subleased properties reached 3,021 as of the end of March 2026, and it has a structure that provides store opening and closing support and store rent guarantees as an integrated service. Another feature is that its operations are spread across seven businesses: mobile telecommunications, staffing, building maintenance, store sublease, real estate sales, wholesale and overseas.
